title: ATOMIC BUILD
question: What are you building, one atom at a time?
note: Atomic design, played as a guessing game. The camera stays in tight on colour chips, type samples and loose tiles while they snap into icons, then bars, a dock, a grey wireframe, and only at the last step pulls back to show a phone home screen. Hiding the whole makes the point better than a diagram: every screen you know is a stack of tiny decisions you never notice until they're stripped back to parts.
